models.construction: Take the seven-point projective plane over the two-element field as a pure Point/Line/Incides structure and forget all coordinatizing field data.
models.witness: The signature has only Point, Line, and Incides sorts/symbols, so a scalar-valued term is syntactically absent.

construction.affine_core: AG(2,3) as a finite affine incidence plane.

models.witness: For every (u,b), delta changes b and fixes u whereas rho(z) changes u and fixes b.

construction.rho_z: rho(z) swaps (0,0)<->(0,1) and fixes all (u,b) with u!=0

models.construction: A single oriented triangular 2-cell has boundary successor group C3.
models.witness: C3 has no nonidentity element of order two.

models.construction: Start from a four-edge oriented polygonal disk C4 and subdivide exactly one boundary edge once, producing a five-edge boundary C5.
satisfies: Both endpoints are S1 finite oriented disks; the operation is a valid local cellular subdivision.
targets: R1 refinement-path independence under unrestricted refinement
models.witness: R1 exists on C4 but not on C5 because the boundary cardinality changes from even to odd.

models.construction: Fix any S5 model (K,V,Point,N,mu) and any c>0 with c!=1. Form a second expansion with the same K,V,Point,N and valuation mu'=c*mu.
satisfies: Both are S5 models and have the same S4+N reduct.
targets: R4_RAW_ISOPERIMETRIC_CUT under coarsening that forgets valuation normalization
models.witness: For every polygon C, Per_N(C)^2/mu'(C)=(1/c) Per_N(C)^2/mu(C), hence J_N,mu'=J_N,mu/c in Cut(K).

models.construction: Take TurnLift=(Z,+), G2=Z/2Z, p(n)=n mod 2. Then ker(p)=2Z.
models.witness: The raw kernel generators are +2 and -2. The automorphism n->-n commutes with p and exchanges them.

preservation_rule: Every countermodel is retained as evidence; none is repaired by adding structure to the frozen signature.
